basic_info.description: Expansive Home with City Views & Room to Grow    Don't miss this spacious and versatile home featuring sweeping city views and a flexible floor plan with three bedrooms/two baths on the upper level and two bedrooms/one bath on the lower level.     The main level welcomes you with a light-filled living room showcasing views of the city, a cozy fireplace, and an open-concept layout that flows seamlessly into the dining area and updated kitchenideal for entertaining and everyday living.    The split-live top floor offers three generously sized bedrooms and two full bathrooms, including a well-appointed primary suite, providing comfort, privacy, and a smart layout.    The lower level adds incredible value with two additional bedrooms, a wet bar, and a bathroom and easy access to the garden perfect for guest quarters, a home office, or additional living space.     Lots of storage in the two-car side-by-side garage with additional parking for two cars in the driveway.
